name: Manicule
brief:
Product: Manicule
One-liner: AgentRel — Devrel For Agents
Description: Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. We own developer documentation and technical content across social channels, end-to-end. We've grown 100% MoM over the last three months to $53K in monthly revenue, with customers like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra. Getting discovered and used by agents is its own job now, and the market for it is broken.
Industry: B2B / Marketing
target:
Tomorrow's Users Aren't Developers. They're Agents.

Manicule gets your product discovered and used by AI agents. Docs, GEO, and social content for how agents read. We provide the data on how agents use you, and the execution on top of it.

See your docs the way agents see them.

Drop a URL and we'll run the same audit our agents run on day one of an engagement: gaps, broken examples, dead ends, GEO surface area. Report in your inbox in about seven minutes.

Docs. Content. Distribution.

We own three things for every customer: docs on our infra, content, and distribution across socials. Docs ship end to end in fourteen days. Every step has a clear owner.

Audit

Our agents crawl your docs, codebase, and support channels. They surface every gap, contradiction, and dead end. We build the diagnosis.

Information Architecture

The sidebar is the first thing developers and agents see. We map the journey from zero to “aha” and design a structure both can navigate without getting lost.

Writing + Review Cycles

Agents draft from your OpenAPI specs and SDK definitions. Our writers refine every page, kill the fluff, and test the mental model. Multiple review cycles with your team until it's right.

Code Verification

Every code snippet gets tested. Our agents run the examples against your actual API, flag failures, and validate edge cases. No more docs that lie about your product.

Videos + Screenshots

Walls of text kill docs. We produce diagrams, annotated screenshots, and short walkthroughs that make complex flows click.

Final Push

GEO and SEO optimization, link validation, accessibility checks, and the launch itself. We ship it live and monitor the first 48 hours for anything we missed.

Content + Distribution

Eight pieces a month. First drafts are fully agentic, loaded with your codebase, calls, and support tickets. Our DevRel team reviews every draft, then repurposes it across socials.

We're Measured on Outcomes

Impressions, inbound, and how agents use and discover you. Our framework reports what agents do in your docs, our agents monitor for drift, and our team pushes updates on a regular cadence.

From Chaos to Clarity

Two overlapping products and a sidebar that confused everyone. We locked the positioning, mapped the developer journey, and rewrote everything.

The Default Name in AI Memory

Docs were step one. Then we ran Supermemory's entire DevRel motion: SEO, social, Reddit, and GEO, all from one strategy.

name: Vela
brief:
Product: Vela
One-liner: AI Recruiting Coordinator for Executive Search
Description: Scheduling one interview panel takes a dozen emails. Then someone moves a call and you start over. Vela is an AI Scheduling Coordinator that handles it end to end. Just CC Vela on the thread like you would a person. It reaches out, finds times that work for everyone, chases the people who don't reply, reschedules when things change, and confirms. Over email, SMS, and WhatsApp, at any hour your candidate happens to respond. No dashboard. No new workflow.
Industry: B2B
target:
Scheduling, solved.

New · We read 70,000 scheduling emails so you don’t have to. The Executive Search Scheduling Benchmark is out. Get the report

Vela is your AI scheduling assistant that gives you back your most valuable resource: time. She books meetings, coordinates across teams & stakeholders, and handles the back-and-forth so you don't have to.

Vela schedules thousands of meetings each week for teams that work with

Live scheduling demo

"Looping in Vela. Please schedule a 60-min discovery call with Rachel from Acme Inc next week."

Scheduling shouldn't be a full-time job.

Every meeting requires coordination. The back-and-forth, the timezone math, the calendar juggling: it all adds up to hours you'll never get back.

Back-and-forth emails

Stop the endless 'does this time work for you?' chains. Vela reads your calendar and handles the negotiation.

Timezone chaos

Stop doing mental math. Vela automatically coordinates across multiple timezones for every participant.

Calendar conflicts

Double bookings are a thing of the past. Vela monitors your availability in real-time and reschedules automatically if conflicts arise.

Professionals use Vela to reclaim their time and focus on what actually matters.

How much time will Vela give back to you?

Adjust the sliders. Vela automatically follows up, proposes times, books, reschedules, and sends confirmations so you don't have to.

Estimates vary by workflow; Vela measures actual time saved once deployed.

One assistant. All your meetings. End-to-end.

CC Vela on email, or text Vela directly. She reads context, coordinates all parties, proposes real options, books, reminds, and reschedules automatically.

Start in your natural flow

CC vela@yourdomain.com on any email, SMS, or WhatsApp. Just say: 'Book a 30-min call with Sarah and Mark next Tuesday morning.'

Vela coordinates everyone

Pulls availability from all participants, proposes times in each person's timezone, and follows up automatically if someone doesn't respond.

Handles changes gracefully

Someone needs to reschedule? Vela re-coordinates with all parties, updates calendar invites, and notifies everyone. No manual work required.

Frequently asked questions

Can Vela handle multi-attendee meetings?

How does Vela know my availability?

What happens if someone needs to reschedule?

Does Vela work with international timezones?

Can I set preferences for meeting types?

How do participants interact with Vela?

Is there an API?

name: General Learning
brief:
Product: General Learning
One-liner: AI tutors for students.
Description: General Learning builds AI-powered learning platforms for the world's major curricula. RevisionDojo, the AI study platform for the IB; OnePrep, the premier AI platform for SAT, ACT, and AP; and MathsGenie, the leading AI platform for GCSE and A-level. Each brand houses pre-loaded question sets, study notes, mini-lessons guided by an AI tutor that adapts to each student individually.
Industry: Education
target:
Pre-20th century

Knowledge concentrated in elites

Private tutors educated the wealthy, and apprenticeships trained everyone else. Most children never attended school, and kindergarten and compulsory education were still decades away.

The Flynn effect

20th century

Mass schooling and standardized tests spread literacy and abstract reasoning worldwide. Yet instruction stayed one-size-fits-all, built for the median student.

The open internet

Wikipedia, online courses, and video made knowledge free and global. Anyone could learn anything, but none of it was personalized.

2022–now

Models answer instantly but hallucinate and do not know what you already know. A real tutor reads student state and routes what to teach next.

Key events

Accelerating Humanity's Rate of Learning.

1 in 4 people on Earth is a student. Education shapes how people think, work, vote, build, and lead. Yet learners have been underserved for most of history.

Human intelligence is not fixed by biology.

It is shaped by environment and the systems we learn from.

With AI and thoughtful design, we accelerate learning outcomes and instructor productivity in parallel.

And for the first time, that advantage can reach all of society.

Advancing learner outcomes in the world's most prominent curriculums

OnePrep is the premier AI learning platform for US SAT, ACT, and AP exams

RevisionDojo is the AI study platform for the International Baccalaureate (IB)

MathsGenie is the leading AI learning platform for UK GCSE and A-level curricula

Better outcomes across students, exams, and classrooms

Mean IB subject score by group, before vs. after and due to RevisionDojo

RevisionDojo users gain over half a point in every IB group

Students improved by close to a full IB grade on average, similar to moving from a letter C to an A or B, consistently across language, humanities, sciences, and mathematics.

The biggest gains go to students who start furthest behind , led by sciences, with every subject group improving.

Self-reported SAT total score by starting band, before and after using OnePrep

OnePrep students see real SAT gains at every starting level

OnePrep turns practice into measurable progress. Across 1,063 users surveyed in December 2025, students gained at every starting score band .

Students starting between 600 and 800 gained the most, up to 378 points , as our models pinpoint weak skills and serve the next problem in milliseconds.

Mean self-reported weekly hours saved by task category, after using RevisionDojo

IB teachers reclaim hours every week

name: Artifact
brief:
Product: Artifact
One-liner: An Collaborative, AI-native IDE for Hardware Engineers
Description: Artifact is a collaborative IDE for hardware engineers - accelerating every step in the engineering lifecycle: Design → Procurement → Manufacturing → Integration → Test → Sustainment We've raised $3.5M to build an integrated, verifiable AI copilot with an intuitive UI that reflects how hardware actually gets built. Every artifact is auto-generated and traceable to a single-source of truth. We believe hardware engineering should be rigorous, deliberate, and system-aware.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The Design Tool for Electrical Systems

Artifact is a collaborative, version-controlled, and multi-layered ECAD tool. It organizes interdependencies between sub-systems and generates harness drawings, pin-tables, and BOMs real-time.

Single source of truth across design, procurement, and manufacturing

Designing boats is hard.

Designing harnesses shouldn't be.

Remove harnesses from the critical path

Parallelize harness design, trace signals across systems, and build with confidence. Artifact structures complex systems and gives tribal knowledge a permanent home.

Align Product Teams

Design, manufacturing, and procurement teams collaborate on the system design in parallel.

Electrical Verification

Run electrical verifications and designs rule checks to catch design errors before the system is built.

Multi-Layered Views

Artifact has Design Blocks and a Navigation Map to see the full system at multiple levels of fidelity.

Security Compliance

Artifact has Aerospace and DoD customers with ITAR and CUI compliant installations

Import the components. Export the system.

Artifact bidirectionally links to your CAD system and generates harness drawings, pin-tables, and BOMs. Everything stays in sync as you increase design fidelity.

How to build your system in Artifact:

Build your Parts Library

Create new parts, bulk upload from .csv, or download parts from Artifact's public library. Define pinouts and metadata once - and use them across all of your projects.

Draw the System Schematics

Drag in devices, connect pins, and add custom annotations. Cleanly visualize power, ground, and data connections throughout your system.

Autogenerate Harness Drawings

Generates harness drawings based on your system schematic. You can edit the drawings to add lengths, custom annotations, and treatments like zipties and overbriad.

Run Electrical Rules Checks

Run electrical rules checks to catch design errors before the system is built. You can also run project rules checks to catch design errors across multiple systems.

Track Design and Build History

Branch designs, save snapshots, and freeze releases. Every change is traceable - so you can always know what changed, when, and why.

Navigate the Project Map

Navigate nested design blocks in the navigation map to see the full system at multiple levels of fidelity. You can also see the dependencies between systems.

Trace Nets and Component Details

name: Overview
brief:
Product: Overview
One-liner: Reshaping industrial quality with AI, hardware, and software
Description: Here’s a secret between you and me: even the world’s largest manufacturers, companies like Tesla and Toyota, waste billions of dollars every year making products with quality issues. Building high-quality things at scale is incredibly hard. It doesn’t just happen because you hire smart people or buy good machines. It requires seeing problems early, understanding them deeply, and acting in real time, something factories were never designed to do. At Overview.ai, we’re changing that.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Deep Learning, IoT, Computer Vision, Manufacturing, AI
target:
AI Machine Vision Systems for Manufacturing

AI Vision Leader in Manufacturing

Deploy powerful automated inspection in days with Gen AI. Our vision systems ensure flawless quality control and find defects others miss.

Overview AI Ecosystem

Our Products

AI vision systems (software pre-loaded)

OV10i AI Vision Sensor

OV20i AI Vision Sensor

OV80i High Performance AI Vision System

OVX Inspection Platform

Additional AI Software Tools

OV Auto-Integration Builder

OV Fleet & Vault

OV AI Expert Helper

Built to Deploy Fast. Built for Zero Missed Defects.

Highest Accuracy AI Models

Vision transformer-based models deliver superior accuracy with less training data.

NVIDIA GPU in Every Smart Camera

On-device AI training and inference with no external compute needed.

100% Edge, Zero Cloud

Your production data never leaves the factory floor.

No Software to Download

Configure everything locally from your browser. Each camera is a local networked device.

Open Platform - Every PLC, Every Protocol

200K+ Production Images On-Device

Faster root cause analysis and model retraining with minimal downtime.

Trusted by manufacturing industry leaders

Global Deployment

In Hundreds of Factories

A Vision System Built for Modern Manufacturing

Deploy powerful automated inspection in days. Our AI vision system delivers real-time defect detection with industry-leading accuracy.

Case Studies

Built for real manufacturing.

Assembly Verification

Every fastener, cable, and cap seated correctly in real time.

Defect Detection

Structural and cosmetic flaws at production rates, sub-millimeter.

Multi-point Inspection

Multiple critical regions verified on a single triggered frame.

Synthetic Defect Generation

Train inspection without breaking a real part.

Contaminant Verification

Trained on synthetic. Validated on a real nail dropped live on the belt.

One reference image, defects authored and deployed across 300+ SKUs.

High Volume, Medium Mix

One labeled defect retargeted across every variant in the catalog.

See Overview catch defects on your parts.

Platform Capabilities

Interoperable and Customizable to Your Factory

Proven on Your Toughest Applications

From micro defects to fast-moving production lines with variable conditions, deep learning vision adapts where rule-based systems fail.

Fast Implementation, Faster Payback

Deploy production systems in hours. Train models in minutes. Achieve ROI in weeks, not quarters.

name: ParadeDB
brief:
Product: ParadeDB
One-liner: Unify application data, vectors, and full-text search in one Postgres
Description: Search without a second system. One Postgres for your application data, full-text search, vector retrieval, and aggregations.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Developer Tools, Analytics, Open Source, Infrastructure, Databases
target:
Just use Postgres.

Search belongs with your application data. When queries get too slow, developers usually reach for systems like Elasticsearch. ParadeDB makes text and vector search, filters, facets, and joins fast in Postgres.

Trusted by the world's most ambitious companies.

Ordinary SQL at extraordinary speeds.

When vanilla Postgres falls short, ParadeDB delivers speeds that go toe to toe with Elasticsearch.

P95 latency · lower is better

ParadeDB 0.25.6 · Postgres 18 . Measured against the 28M row Hacker News dataset with paradedb/benchmarker .

No Elasticsearch. Zero ETL.

ParadeDB pairs Postgres' transactional storage with a unified index combining inverted, vector, and columnar data structures.

More than OLTP

OLTP databases are built for reliable transactions, but not for search. The ParadeDB index brings search-optimized data structures and query execution paths to Postgres.

More than search

Search engines and vector stores like Elasticsearch index a separate copy of your data for search. ParadeDB keeps your application data in one place without any schema changes

Fully Postgres native.

Built on the world's most-admired open-source database, proven in production at every scale.

Shipped as an extension

Pure Postgres extension, not a fork. Drops into any self-managed Postgres. Or let us run it for you .

Built as an index

No sidecar process, no external cluster — just a native index on your tables.

Standard SQL

Joins, CTEs, window functions, JSONB, PL/pgSQL, row level security (RLS), materialized views. Search is a WHERE clause.

ACID transactions

Commits, rollbacks, and foreign keys, all with read after write guarantees.

Postgres replication

High availability through physical replication, plus horizontal read scaling with read replicas, available on the Enterprise plan .

The Postgres ecosystem

Case Studies

Trusted by enterprises.

The most innovative companies use ParadeDB to do more with Postgres.

Faster writes after replacing up to 26 B-tree and GIN indexes over one table with a single ParadeDB index.

Reduction in query timeouts across Bilt's resident search, with P95 query latency down 50%.

Lower query latency than Lucene at high concurrency in AnalyticDB benchmarks.

Loved by developers.

Open source since day one. Always.

Our Docker image is the easiest way to quickly spin up ParadeDB.

ParadeDB is one of the fastest-growing database projects.

New faces are always welcome. Pick up an issue and ship it with us.

Ready, set, deploy.

name: Hebbian Robotics
brief:
Product: Hebbian Robotics
One-liner: APIs for robotics data teams to verify data quality for model training
Description: Hebbian Robotics builds APIs for robotics data teams to verify data quality for model training. Our customers use us to build quality control pipelines in just a few lines of code, with custom models 10x faster and 8x cheaper than general foundation models. https://hebbianrobotics.com/ https://github.com/Hebbian-Robotics/hflow
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Robotics, Data Science, Data Engineering, AI, Databases
target:
Verify quality of robotics data for model training

One pipeline for every way you collect.

Egocentric

UMI

Teleoperation

Autonomous rollout

Models trained for robotics data QC.

General models were not built to judge robotics data. We train and host checks for the questions robotics data teams actually ask: are the wearer's hands in view, is there active manipulation, and more.

Video-hours processed per day

Cost per video-hour

Build the pipeline with our open source SDK.

HFlow is an SDK built for first class support of our APIs. Register our checks or write your own as plain Python functions, run them against every episode, and keep the inputs, outputs, versions, and measurements around each step.

From raw recordings to reliable datasets.

HFlow turns multimodal recordings into traceable, quality-scored episodes and a queryable catalog. Each stage produces an output you can inspect, reproduce, and own.

Collect

Land synchronized video, state, action, and sensor streams as one MCAP episode.

Process

Run your transformations, quality checks, labels, and enrichments as a visible pipeline.

Curate

Query metadata and quality evidence across the corpus without loading the recordings.

Deliver

Produce version-pinned manifests and curated episodes for downstream applications.

Evidence you own.

Recordings stay MCAP, results stay Parquet, schedules stay Airflow DAGs. Everything we produce about your data is readable without us.

Questions we get asked.

About Hebbian Robotics, the hosted checks and models, and HFlow. Questions about using the SDK itself are answered in the repository.

MCAP files with ROS 2 topics are read directly, LeRobot v3 datasets are imported by the built-in importer, and any other format takes a small converter written once. The recordings themselves can be human egocentric capture, UMI-style handheld gripper demonstrations, robot teleoperation, or autonomous policy rollouts. If your collection system produces something else, we can help you bring it in.

Yes. HFlow, its built-in checks, and the catalog run where you run them, locally or in an Airflow environment you operate, and recordings, catalogs, and manifests stay in your storage. Calling a hosted check sends only the sampled frames that check needs, and nothing is sent unless you register one. When we deploy with you, what the system can see is agreed up front.

name: Palisade
brief:
Product: Palisade
One-liner: AI that finds and fixes OS-level vulnerabilities across device fleets
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: SaaS, B2B, Cybersecurity, AI
target:
AI that detects and fixes OS vulnerabilities — across every endpoint, in minutes.

Palisade watches your systems at the kernel — syscalls, eBPF traces, process and memory events, live network packets — finds the vulnerabilities other tools miss, and applies the fix fleet-wide. Privilege escalation, remote code execution, memory corruption: caught before the exploit lands.

Any local process can query 169.254.169.254 and harvest instance credentials — the same path behind the Capital One breach.

Simulation of the live product — same rules, same syscalls. Watch it run against a real kernel →

THE GAP

Modern attacks target the operating system. Most security tools are watching everything else.

Network, cloud, and application-layer products can't see what happens inside the kernel. That leaves OS vulnerabilities among the hardest problems to detect — and the slowest to fix. Even after you find one, rolling a mitigation out across hundreds or thousands of machines takes weeks.

From user to root

A single local privesc turns any foothold into full control of the host — and of everything scheduled on it.

Payloads out of nowhere

Unknown binaries executing from /tmp is the classic opening move. By the time it's in your SIEM, it already ran.

Invisible from outside

Use-after-free and heap bugs live below every agent that only reads logs. Detection requires kernel-level visibility.

HOW IT WORKS

Deploys alongside your OS. No rip-and-replace.

Palisade ships as a module next to your existing operating system and attaches at the LSM-BPF layer. AI runs directly on kernel data — then every fix becomes an ordinary, inspectable rule.

See the layer nothing else can

Syscalls, eBPF traces, process and memory events, live network packets — streamed from the kernel in real time. AI finds the vulnerabilities monitoring tools miss.

AI finds it. You approve the fix.

The host audit ranks real findings by severity. Every finding ships a vetted maintainer fix — nothing is changed behind your back. One click installs it as a kernel rule.

Flip to enforcing. The attack dies at the first syscall.

Matched operations return -EPERM from the kernel itself. The payload never executes; the connection is never made. A rollout that took weeks lands fleet-wide in minutes.

AI-NATIVE POLICY

Write policy in English. Enforce it in the kernel.

Describe the rule the way you'd say it in a security review. Palisade compiles it into a kernel-enforced BPF policy — and rejects deny-all footguns before they ever reach the kernel.

name: HeyCharge
brief:
Product: HeyCharge
One-liner: Low-cost, high-scale EV charging platform for apartments (and more).
Description: EV charging infrastructure today is expensive, difficult to install, and doesn't integrate well with existing products, services, and businesses. HeyCharge solves all of these problems with ultra-low-cost, plug-and-play EV chargers that don't require internet connections and integrate with third-party products via our SDK and APIs. Our customers are energy utilities, property operators, mobility service providers, and more.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Climate
target:
EV Charging Without Internet

Offline EV charging via Bluetooth. 100% reliable, 40–70% lower cost.

Democratizing EV Charging for Every Apartment Resident Commercial Building Shopping Mall Rural Community Single Family Home Hotel Retail Store Vacation Home Parking Operator Fleet Operator Company Car Driver

Trusted by real estate leaders

Platform partners

Backed by

Why HeyCharge

Built different. Works better.

Lower Total Cost

No SIM cards. No network infrastructure. No connectivity fees. Eliminate the hidden costs that destroy CPO margins.

Reliable

Works in underground garages where WiFi and cellular fail. Bluetooth EV charging access works everywhere, every time.

Perchtinger Straße, Munich

Retrofit Ready

Works with existing OCPP chargers. No need to replace your hardware.

Turnkey Hardware

Hang it, wire it, charge — the HW18 wallbox ships ready to install, with SecureCharge built in. 22 kW, 3-phase, Eichrecht-certified, available Europe-wide from HUMAX.

Expandable

Start offline, add smart energy management and demand response via gateway.

Offline Roaming

A HeyCharge exclusive: accept EMP charging cards even on fully offline chargers. Company car drivers pay with their Shell, DKV, or EnBW card — no internet at the charger, no RFID reader needed. The app handles card authentication locally via Bluetooth and settles through Hubject when connectivity returns. All the reliability and cost savings of offline, with full roaming payment support.

Our Approach

Different user groups, different products, one mission.

We empower businesses to deliver seamless EV charging to the people who need it most.

Apartment Residents

Enabling property managers and housing companies to offer hassle-free charging to tenants in multi-apartment buildings.

Vacation Rentals

Helping hotels and vacation rentals provide convenient charging as a premium amenity for their guests.

Company Car Drivers

Employees charge company vehicles at home with precise, auditable session tracking — no matter what wallbox they have.

How It Works

Offline-first. By design.

Our patented Bluetooth EV charging technology enables secure authentication and billing without any internet connection — in underground garages, apartment buildings, and beyond.

Bluetooth Connect

User opens the app and connects directly to the charger via Bluetooth. No cellular or WiFi needed.

Local Authentication

Patented cryptographic protocols verify the user directly at the charger. Instant access, always.

Syncs when Online

Session data syncs to the cloud whenever connectivity becomes available. Nothing is lost.

Two ways to deploy

HeyCharge-Operated

Full turnkey CPO service in Germany. We handle everything from installation to operations.

HeyCharge Platform

Enable your charging network with HeyCharge technology. Turnkey, retrofit, or direct integration.

name: hoop.dev
brief:
Product: hoop.dev
One-liner: Code review for DevOps tasks
Description: hoop.dev prevents developers from blocking on Devops tasks. We do this by enabling any engineer do Devops work under the supervision of the Devops team. You can think of us as code review for Devops tasks.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, DevSecOps
target:
Autonomous agents need autonomous controls.

AI AGENT SIDECAR

A security agent that inspects every command your AI agents send to your infrastructure, masks what shouldn’t be seen, and blocks what shouldn’t run.

Trusted by engineering and security teams at

THE PROBLEM

Agents act decisively, without context.

An agent with database credentials runs whatever the prompt leads it to. It doesn’t know which table holds regulated data, or that this DELETE is missing its WHERE clause. It just executes, at machine speed, with everything those credentials allow.

You choose what your agents can do, and what they can’t.

Keep your regulated data private and your production systems online.

Agents query, inspect, and analyze whatever they need. Sensitive fields are masked in the response, so the agent never sees raw PII, credentials, or secrets.

Every write is evaluated before it lands. Low-risk changes pass through. High-risk changes route to a human in Slack or Teams with the exact command attached.

DROP TABLE, delete namespace, rm -rf. Commands that match your guardrail patterns never reach the resource. No exceptions.

An agent scores each remaining action for intent and syntax risk before it executes. The edge cases get judgment instead of a default allow.

Governance that Unblocks the AI Roadmap

The Blocked Use Case

The head of AI wants to let agents query the transaction database, but Compliance blocked the request. Now, hoop.dev masks PII at the wire, so the agent gets its data, compliance gets the audit trail, and the project ships.

The AI Agent

An AI agent needed to query production. hoop.dev masked the sensitive fields before the agent saw them and blocked a destructive command while everything else ran normally. Security read about it in the weekly report instead of getting paged at 3 AM.

OPA for AI Agents

You have OPA at admission and Terraform in CI, but once an agent is connected to the database, nothing is enforcing policy on the session itself. hoop.dev applies rules at the wire: reads flow with masked responses, risky writes wait for approval, and every action lands in one replayable log.

HOW IT ATTACHES

No new infrastructure. No code changes.

The hoop.dev sidecar is a no-code, lightweight proxy that inspects and controls the contents of network traffic before it affects your resources.

You keep your existing IGA and PAM, we make sure every interaction between your agents and infrastructure is safe and documented.

Attach one sidecar. Watch it work on your own traffic.

brief:
Product: Rig - Local-First AI Coding Assistant
Description: A complete AI coding agent that executes entirely on your machine. No API calls. No usage caps. No cloud dependency.
target:
On-device AI coding. No cloud. No limits.

A complete coding agent that executes entirely on your machine. No API calls. No usage caps.

You don't own your AI. And you're being watched.

They train on your code.

Every prompt. Every file. Every fix. It flows through infrastructure you don't control — improving systems they want to use to replace you.

They meter your ambition.

Slowdowns, overages, caps. Right when you're deep in a sprint, the meter decides you've had enough.

They change the model.

They silently downgrade to cheaper models during peak load. Full price, degraded experience.

They control your flow.

Every completion makes a round trip across the internet. Thousands of tiny interruptions, every single day.

Everything local. Own your AI.

A complete AI coding agent running entirely on your own hardware. No usage limits. No cloud dependency.

Work offline

Flights. Spotty Wi-Fi. Network outages. Nothing stops your flow.

Remove the meter

Refactor the whole codebase. Riff on an idea all day. Run agent loops without thinking about cost.

Sever the connection

Your code, keystrokes, and files never leave your machine. Not anonymized. Not aggregated. Not sent.

Stop waiting

No round-trip to a data center. Inference happens on your machine, in single-digit milliseconds.

Purpose beats scale.

Rig is a closed system — model, context, tools, and inference — engineered together for one job: real coding work.

A focused model, trained specifically for coding.

Every parameter in the model is dedicated to coding, planning, tool use, and structured edits. The entire training process is focused on engineering work.

By narrowing the domain, we concentrate intelligence where it matters — deeper reasoning, better code, sharper tool use.

Full intelligence, compressed to fit your machine.

The model is compressed to run efficiently on consumer machines — carefully preserving the reasoning patterns that matter most.

The result is an 8 GB model that fits comfortably in memory on a MacBook. Full reasoning. Local execution. Zero cost per token.

A custom runtime, engineered for Apple Silicon.

The model runs through a custom inference engine optimized specifically for Apple Silicon. Model, context engine, and tools are designed as a single coordinated system.

That tight integration is what makes local execution fast, reliable, and practical.

Your machine, unleashed.

Understands your architecture.

Builds a connected model of modules, dependencies, and relationships so reasoning happens across files and aligns with your architecture.

Tracks relationships, prevents breakage.

Edits that respect function contracts, type boundaries, and dependency graphs — reducing bugs and regressions.

Strategizes before acting.

name: Arpio
brief:
Product: Arpio
One-liner: Recover from any outage in 10 minutes or less.
Description: Arpio is a SaaS that eliminates downtime for AWS applications by making it easy to recover from any outage in just a few minutes.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Cloud Workload Protection, SaaS, B2B
target:
Disaster Recovery for the Cloud & Agentic Applications

Complete disaster recovery and cyber resilience built for your environment, your application, and your agents. Arpio orchestrates fast, comprehensive failover, so your business can recover from any outage, cyberattack, or other cloud disaster.

How Arpio Works

Automated, Orchestrated Recovery from End to End Arpio continuously analyzes your applications, maps dependencies, replicates infrastructure, and builds a clean recovery environment — so you're ready if disaster strikes.

Core Platform Capabilities:

Application-Aware DR

Dependency mapping across services and resources ensures seamless orchestration and failover

Safe Failover Testing, Anytime

Predictable, validated RTO/RPO performance — without disrupting production

Push-Button Recovery

Recover quickly from outages. Recover safely from ransomware. Zero data loss.

Failback Automation

Failback to your primary environment with the click of a button, or continue running in your recovery environment. Up to you.

Resilience, Simplified

Disaster recovery in the cloud is complicated. Arpio makes it simple: no scripts, no runbooks, no long DR projects. Just automated, application-aware recovery whenever you need it. With Arpio, you can:

Recover applications quickly and consistently

Validate readiness with continuous health checks

Simplify operations with automation

Eliminate manual processes that introduce risk

Meet stringent compliance and uptime requirements

Ensure that you’re prepared to recover from a ransomware attack

TRUSTED BY CLOUD-FORWARD COMPANIES WORLDWIDE

Purpose-Built DR Orchestration for AWS and Azure

Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Automated AWS disaster recovery with cross-account and cross-region failover.

Microsoft Azure

Automated Azure DR with cross-subscription orchestration and cloud-native replication.

Protect Your Business from the Unexpected

Regional Outages

Maintain operational continuity during cloud outages with minimal disruption.

Ransomware Attacks

Recover safely from ransomware attacks without giving in to ransom demands.

Bad Actors

Whether it's insider threats or outside hackers, your business will always be able to recover.

Human Error

Mistakes happen. Never. Lose. Data. Arpio's got your back.

Outages? They’re handled. Ransomware? It’s a setback, not a disaster. With Arpio, you’re prepped with a recovery environment your adversaries can’t touch, ready to switch on like a backup generator.

“Arpio’s automated disaster recovery solution gives us the confidence that our systems will continue to operate if disaster strikes.”

Jason Simpson

VP of Engineering, Choice Hotels

“After our implementation, we've had great success with our ongoing DR tests, and the platform is easy for everyone on the team to understand.”

Ryan Eade

CTO, Spiffy

name: CandorIQ
brief:
Product: CandorIQ
One-liner: Headcount & Compensation Management
Description: CandorIQ is software to manage Headcount and Compensation planning. Employees are +70% of all OPEX and yet still managed in sheets & email. We manage all people spend in 1 platform, integrated into your Finance & HR stack. Product capabilities include: - Headcount & backfill planning - Headcount budget scenarios across departments - Merit cycle planning - Analytics including employee churn, hiring win/loss, cash burn
Industry: B2B
target:
AI Native Workforce Planning for Finance & HR

Automating services and tools for Headcount, Compensation & Sales Planning at the speed of AI

Trusted by 100s of companies

Your systems capture decisions after they're made

CandorIQ connects all your existing Finance and HR systems into the world's only workforce graph, and automates the planning work that happens between them. No spreadsheets. No consultants.

Model any hire or headcount change and see the budget impact before you commit. CandorIQ brings HR and Finance into one workflow to run scenarios, forecast spend, and keep hiring aligned to plan.

Run merit cycles in days instead of months. Your Compensation Agent builds recommendations, tracks budget versus spend, and generates reward letters and reports, start to finish.

Your HR Agent analyzes your workforce data to surface retention risk early, then turns employee data into proactive decisions you can act on before people leave.

Meet your team of AI Agents

CandorIQ brings four specialized AI agents into your workflows: a Finance Agent for headcount planning and budgets, a Compensation Agent for pay strategy and comp cycles, a Recruiting Agent for offers and hiring workflows, and an HR Agent for workforce insights and analysis.

Build ladders and leveling with AI assistance

Upload job descriptions and let AI match roles, structure ladders, and map employees automatically. What used to take months with consultants can now be built and maintained directly inside CandorIQ.

Know how your pay compares to the market

AI agents analyze millions of benchmarking data points alongside your internal data to surface pay gaps, suggest ranges, and visualize how your compensation compares to the market.

Test workforce strategies before you commit

Run “what-if” scenarios across hiring plans, budgets, geographies, and the mix of humans and AI teammates. AI agents help model growth targets, cost impact, and organizational changes so leaders can plan with clarity.

Operate and analyze your workforce

Track workforce trends, analyze retention risk, and generate charts and reports instantly. The HR Agent helps People teams understand what’s happening across the org—and take action faster.

Run comp cycles and build job architecture faster

Create ladders, map employees to roles, and match job descriptions automatically — turning multi-month work into a few days. During comp cycles, the agent generates audit-ready reports and analysis instantly.

Generate offers in minutes, not half an hour

The Recruiting Agent prepares candidate offers automatically based on pay ranges, approvals, and historical accept/decline patterns—shrinking a recruiter’s offer prep from ~30 minutes to about 3.

brief:

One-liner: UI building blocks for the agentic internet
Description: 21st.dev is the largest React component registry for AI applications, used by 2M developers We provide the building blocks to create agent-powered apps: UI components, agent templates.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
target:
The living library of interfaces

12,000+ crafted React components, templates, and shadcn themes. Built by real design engineers.

2,000+ Marketing blocks :

2,100+ UI components :

Used by 3,571,789 builders . From indie makers to the world's largest product teams

Startups:

Copy the prompt. Paste it anywhere

Every component ships as a prompt. One copy — and it builds itself in whatever tool you live in.

Paste it in the terminal — the source lands in your repo.

Same prompt as a task — Codex ships it with a diff.

Paste it in chat — the exact UI appears in your project.

React + Tailwind, shadcn/ui conventions — every component is source that lands in your repo, yours to edit.

Number Ticker

Bookmark any component into your lists — personal or team-shared — and pull it back up in one click.

Built by real design engineers . Every component has an author. Indexed, searchable, one prompt away

Built by humans Ready for agents

Questions, answered

Everything you need to know about the registry, installing components, and publishing your own.

21st is a community catalog of UI built by design engineers: React components, full templates, shadcn themes, shaders, and gradients. You browse them, preview them live, and copy an AI-ready prompt that drops any component into your project through Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable, or any other AI agent.

Yes. Browsing the whole registry is free, and you get 2 free component copies every day. Membership unlocks unlimited copies and premium templates from their authors. 21st AI, for generating and refining UI, is an add-on you turn on with a monthly credit allowance.

A component library is one package with one aesthetic, installed as a dependency. 21st is a registry: many authors, many styles, and the code is copied into your repo rather than imported. You own it and can change it — there is no version of us to upgrade.

Hit Copy prompt on any component and paste it into your AI tool — Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Lovable — and the agent rebuilds it inside your codebase, wired to your stack. That's how most people ship components from 21st. Prefer the classic way? Every component also comes with a shadcn CLI install command.

name: Aside
brief:
Product: Aside
One-liner: The browser built to do real work for you
Description: Aside is an AI browser that completes real work across the websites you already use. It can sign in through your browser, work inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets, and keep going when a task takes minutes or hours. Unlike agents that depend on integrations, Aside uses the web the way you do. Browsing history becomes local memory, so it knows which tools and context matter. Its password manager lets agents autofill credentials without exposing secrets to the AI.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Automation
target:
The most intelligent AI assistant, but it’s a browser.

Finding website design example

Today’s AI browsers are broken. They never complete a task. They say “I can’t do this” every time. They stop every time the work gets real, and they still lack the basics: speed and usability.

Aside is a browser rebuilt for people and agents. It works across your logged-in websites and handles complex work other agents can’t: messages, payments, internal tools, and everything in between.

Unlimited capability

Anything you do in a browser, Aside can do for you.

Unlike other AI agents that rely on integrations, Aside just uses websites and accounts directly, just like you do. That means you can ask any task in your mind anytime you need. The only wall is the imagination.

Signing in Aside signs in and works across your email, dashboards, and internal tools.

Communications Aside handles comments, replies, and follow-ups for you.

Docs and Spreadsheets Aside can work with files directly on your computer.

The SOTA browser agent.

Aside ranked #1 on three browser agent benchmarks: Online-Mind2Web, BU-Bench-V1, and Odysseys, surpassing OpenAI, Anthropic, and Browser Use. Learn more

Memory that knows what you’re working on.

Aside knows which sites to use for which work. It turns your browsing history into memory, so you don’t have to repeat context every time. All memory stays local on your device and is never shared with anyone. Learn more

Password Manager

Bild AI reads blueprints and specs, generates opening (door) schedules automatically, prices the bid, and exports it directly into the ERPs Division 8 shops already run on, including Comsense, Avaware, and ProTech. target:
Fast and accurate Division 8 takeoffs

For Division 8 distributors & estimators

AI-powered takeoffs of doors, frames, and hardware. Empower your estimators to bid more without sacrificing accuracy.

A 5-minute Division 8 walkthrough

Takeoff in hours instead of days.

Trusted by Division 8 distributors & estimators nationwide

Designed by estimators, for estimators

Built for every step of estimating and detailing.

Schedule & spec extraction

Doors, frames, and hardware — pulled straight from the packet.

Extract the door schedule and hardware sets buried in the plans and specs. They're standardized and mapped — opening to hw set.

Door Schedule

Power Plan

Door Hardware

Floor Plan

Door Types

Hardware set automation

Sets that split themselves.

Kick plates, thresholds, astragals, etc. intelligently sized by leaf/opening dimensions.

Floor plan visualization

Every opening, on the plan.

Located doors on the floor plan, tagged by configuration (SG/UEP), and reconciled against the door schedule.

Manufacturer cross-reference

Approved alternates, mapped from the catalog.

Swap hinges, closers, locksets — and the rest of the spec. Value engineer in minutes, not days.

Web-based takeoffs with AI assistant

Estimate and detail online.

18 openings updated. Kick plates resized. Export ready when you are.

Integrates into your workflow

Diffs between drawing sets.

The ROI

1.5x bid volume. Per estimator.

40-60% more bids per estimator with the same high accuracy and attention to detail. The increased bids are directly attributable to Bild AI.

Source: Division 8 distributor, $100M+ annual revenue.

Win more Division 8 bids this quarter.

name: Casco
brief:
Product: Casco
One-liner: Autonomous security testing for web apps, APIs, cloud, and AI systems
Description: Casco performs autonomous security testing for your web apps, APIs, infrastructure, and AI systems. Human supervision optionally available. Use Casco for year-round security and get a penetration test report for your SOC2 and ISO27001 compliance certifications. Trusted by 100+ companies from enterprises to fast-moving startups, such as Gusto, CrewAI, Novig, and Accrual.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Ship fast, secure faster.

Casco is an AI penetration testing platform that continuously tests web apps, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and AI systems. It proves exploitable paths and retests every fix.

Why teams keep Casco running.

Hear from the teams that put Casco against their real attack surface and brought the findings back to engineering.

A pentester that learns your web apps

Follow one authenticated attack from discovery to a human-verified fix without leaving the page behind.

Your live attack surface, mapped.

Agents learn identities, endpoints, data stores, and the paths between them.

Coverage that follows your stack.

Live workflows turn every signal into tested evidence, retained context, and a clear next action.

Every report investigated.

Claims are separated, tested safely, and returned with proof.

Know exactly what Casco touched.

Every request stays attributable, scoped, and reviewable.

A false positive happens once.

Dismissed findings become context for every future operation.

Ask Casco questions from the tools you already use, connect live system context to each test, and route verified findings directly to the team responsible for the fix.

Customer agents

Stay connected to the pentest from the tools you already use.

Systems Casco tests

Connect source, cloud, CI, and runtime context to the test.

Team ticketing

Move validated findings directly into the team’s workflow.

Every release starts with what Casco already learned.

Scope, identities, and proven attack paths carry forward. Casco tests what changed and replays the attacks that mattered. Explore continuous pentesting

A pentest report that clears the toughest security reviews

Casco pentests have cleared procurement with Microsoft, Google, AMD, and Apple. Every Casco pentest can optionally include human review by OSCE, OSCP, CREST, and PCI-certified security engineers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers for security teams, engineering leaders, and anyone evaluating a modern pentest.

Casco is an AI-powered penetration testing platform that helps security teams find, validate, and fix exploitable vulnerabilities. Its security agents test your applications and infrastructure, reproduce real attack paths, and provide evidence and remediation guidance. Casco also helps triage external security findings by investigating incoming reports and validating their impact in your environment, so your team can separate signal from noise and focus on the issues that matter. Explore security report triage

Deploy to every tenant

Backed by the best

Your clients now want AI from you.

One build, every tenant

Agents that are horizontal and vertical-specific.

Instant pricing clarity. Automated negotiations. Real savings. Meet Ruth

PRICING AGENT

NEGOTIATION AGENT

Surface overcharges, renewal traps, and negotiable terms by analyzing your existing software contracts.

Sören Petsch Head of Procurement , Root Insurance

Skip the sales calls entirely

Vendr negotiates asynchronously over email, on your behalf. No meetings, no back-and-forth, no stress. Just savings delivered to your inbox.

Designed to handle growth and extend across your stack.

Built to integrate

brief:
Product: Flock Safety
One-liner: The first public safety operating system that eliminates crime.
Description: Flock Safety provides the first public safety operating system that empowers private communities and law enforcement to work together to eliminate crime. We are committed to protecting human privacy and mitigating bias in policing with the development of best-in-class technology rooted in ethical design, which unites civilians and public servants in pursuit of a safer, more equitable society.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Hardware, Machine Learning, SaaS
target:
Better tools for safer communities

Flock builds technology that helps communities deter crime, respond to emergencies, and investigate safety incidents. We believe communities shouldn't have to choose between public safety and privacy.

Public safety works better together

Flock brings together the tools that organizations rely on every day, helping law enforcement, schools, businesses, and neighborhoods respond faster, investigate more effectively, and work together from the same platform.

Raising the bar

Building technology responsibly means never standing still. We continually improve privacy, accountability, and security guardrails across the products communities rely on.

This year, we've:

Reduced our recommended default data retention from 30 days to 7 days

Given customers more control over how data is shared across agencies

Expanded audit requirements and proactive monitoring to detect misuse

Made multi-factor authentication mandatory for every customer

Increased transparency around data ownership, security, and agency policies

Because protecting communities also means protecting civil liberties.

brief:
Product: DryMerge

Description: We create AI agents that constantly monitor emails, calendar, calls, or wherever else companies have relationship data and organize it into CRM records as meticulously as a great rep would. We build these agents on top of the DryMerge platform, a tool to build AI agents that integrate with business apps and work in the background.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, CRM, Automation
target:
AI that updates your CRM for you

Our AI agents constantly monitor your email, calendar, and calls to keep your CRM updated with every detail.

How DryMerge Works

Your Journey to a Perfect CRM

Connect Your Data Sources

Integrate your business tools and CRM system in minutes.

AI Agents Monitor Communications

Intelligent agents analyze emails, meetings, messages, and more to extract valuable insights.

Perfect CRM Data, Automatically

Watch as DryMerge ensures your CRM data is always complete, accurate, and up-to-date without any manual effort.

Unbelievably good activity capture

You deserve better than incomplete CRM data. Our AI analyzes every interaction as thoroughly as your best team member—capturing context, relationship dynamics, next steps, and deal insights automatically.

Connect with any business tool

We integrate with 50+ business apps, including Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Teams, and numerous other tools. No matter where your relationship data lives, DryMerge can connect to it and add it to your CRM.

Always on in the background

Our AI agents work 24/7, 365 days a year, never missing a beat or needing a break. Your team can use apps like usual, and DryMerge will work tirelessly to curate your perfect CRM with no manual effort needed.

Perfectly fits your deal process

Our agents are tuned to fit your exact deal process. They capture the specific information you need, use your custom fields, adopt your communication style, and move data according to your existing workflows.

What our customers say

Michael Scarola

Chief Operating Officer, Altai Capital

"DryMerge has significantly enhanced our investment due diligence recordkeeping efforts. The beauty is that we continue to work in familiar applications while DryMerge passively captures and relates activity to relevant records in our Salesforce CRM in the background."

Cameron Barnes

Director, Operations, ContextLogic Inc.

"DryMerge has been a game-changer for our team. Its intuitive automation allows us to seamlessly aggregate and map key information, significantly enhancing our ability to manage complex workflows. DryMerge has transformed how we leverage data, saving us countless hours."

Chris Weaver

Chief Executive Officer, Onyx AI

"We use DryMerge to create notes, contacts, and accounts in our HubSpot CRM after calls. Our team saves over 10 hours a week on CRM data entry with DryMerge, with absolutely no reduction in data quality."

Industry-leading security and reliability

name: Momence
brief:
Product: Momence
One-liner: Scheduling and payments for experiences
Industry: Consumer / Travel, Leisure and Tourism
Tags: Payments, Scheduling
target:
Build your studio, your way

FLEXIBLE FITNESS STUDIO SOFTWARE

You bring the vision. Momence brings bookings, payments, and marketing together in one flexible and intuitive platform—so your software doesn't limit what your business can become.

Join thousands of fitness and wellness businesses growing with Momence

THE MOMENCE DIFFERENCE

Run your whole business on one platform—with less manual work

Momence isn’t a booking system surrounded by disconnected tools. It’s one platform where your schedule, payments, marketing, and customer activity work off the same information. Spend less time piecing things together and more time doing what you love.

Create classes, appointments, workshops, events, retreats, spaces, and on-demand experiences.

Learn more

Offer memberships, packs, intro offers, drop-ins, subscriptions, and other pricing models that fit your business.

Bring customer messages and activity together so your team always has the full picture.

Capture leads, automate follow-up, and build campaigns around real booking, attendance, and purchase behavior.

Track performance across attendance, customers, memberships, marketing, and revenue.

Accept payments, manage billing, and keep your revenue connected to the rest of your operation.

Powerful tools that don’t require a software expert

Create new offerings, adjust pricing, build automated journeys, and understand performance through intuitive tools designed for owners and teams to use confidently.

Make growth part of how your studio runs

Momence turns everyday customer activity into opportunities to grow. Welcome new leads, convert intro offers, fill open spots, bring customers back, and strengthen retention with marketing built directly into your studio platform.

Keep your studio moving when you can't be there

Bring conversations into one connected inbox, automate routine follow-up, and let AI help answer questions and handle eligible customer requests.

See the full picture of every client

Every booking, purchase, membership, message, and marketing interaction stays connected in Momence. Your team gets the context it needs to provide better service and your marketing can respond to what clients actually do.

Put your studio in your customers’ hands

Give customers an easy way to discover offerings, book and pay, manage memberships, and stay connected—through the Momence app or an app built around your brand.

Built for the way you want to grow

Whether you offer classes, appointments, workshops, events, on-demand content, space rentals–or a mix of it all–Momence gives you the flexibility to shape the platform around the experience-based business you want to build.

Get in touch with the team

name: The Human Utility
brief:
Product: The Human Utility
One-liner: The Human Utility seeks to eliminate water service disconnections for…
Description: Founded July 2014, The Human Utility (formerly known as the Detroit Water Project) matches families needing help with utility bills to people who want to help through payments directly to utility companies. For over 40 million families in the United States, water and other essential utilities may be unaffordable. In order to afford utilities, families often forgo medication, food, and transportation.
Industry: Unspecified
Tags: Crowdfunding
target:
We believe affordable water is a human right. Do you?

Generous donors have paid $90,666 in water bills (click/tap for listing) in 2026.

Since July 2014, over 4,500 people who believe water is a human right have helped over 2,000 families with their water bills.

Yes, I want to help with a water bill I need help with my water bill

Dignity for everyone, everyday.

Water is a human right. But, the United States has a water affordability problem. In places like Detroit, Baltimore, and other cities, families unable to afford their water bills have their water shut off. When this happens, kids can't bathe, people can't wash dishes, and grandparents can't flush their toilets. The Human Utility is non-profit organization providing help to families and makes sure they always have running water at home.

On a Water Moratorium: Michigan is Not Out of the Woods Yet

The state of Michigan issued a moratorium on water shutoffs during the novel coronavirus crisis. What does that mean for the future of water affordability in Michigan, though? Check out our thoughts on the moratorium here .

Why can't people afford their water bills?

This is the question we're asked the most. Start here to learn why water isn't affordable.

You can help families

Hope Against Hardship: How Determination And The Human Utility Helped A Mother Fight Hopelessness

A mother in Detroit with two hemophiliac boys works to make sure their home remains a clean, safe environment, but water bills make that difficult.

How a Leaky Toilet Broke Up a Family — And How It’s Being Put Back Together

Patricia G., a 57-year-old Detroit resident, was overcome with emotion. She’d just gotten the phone call letting her know The Human Utility paid $750 toward her water bill. Patricia was getting her water turned back on.

You Can Get Involved

Donate

Your donation will go directly to help seniors and families living without water or in danger of shut-off. Donate any amount, starting at $5.

Provide Services

If you are a lawyer, plumber, or other business owner able to help residents with water bill-related needs, you are needed! Learn how you can help.

Partner with us

If you’re a community organization in Detroit or Baltimore working to connect residents with services and support, we’d love to partner with you.

You'll be in great company.

name: Pelica
brief:
Product: Pelica
One-liner: AI agents for risk-bearing healthcare organizations
Description: Pelica helps risk-bearing healthcare organizations improve quality performance, close care gaps, and lower administrative cost using specialized AI agents. Built for health plans, IPAs, MSOs, ACOs, and risk-bearing medical groups, Pelica unifies claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and ADT data into one live member record, then gives quality, risk adjustment, pharmacy, provider network, and care management teams agents that carry work through to completion.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare IT
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Healthcare, Healthcare IT, AI
target:
The AI operating system for quality, risk, and care operations.

Pelica’s AI workforce helps teams close quality gaps, lift adherence, coordinate providers, manage care workflows, and reduce avoidable utilization with less manual coordination behind every step.

Lives managed

To go live

One canonical record. Every workflow. Real-time.

Three layers. Each addressable on its own. Deployed together, the equivalent of 8 to 15 point vendors in a single platform.

A copilot for every team. One canonical record they all read from.

Each copilot is powered by 80+ specialized AI agents and independently useful on its own. Because they read and write to the same record, an HCC captured by Risk informs the Network agenda; a Part D gap closed by Pharmacy updates the Stars projection.

Risk Adjustment

Real-time HCC capture, RADV-defensible.

Quality & Stars

Unified gap closure across every payer.

Pharmacy & Part D

PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures.

Provider Network

EMR overlay. Providers get credit for care already delivered.

Care Management

ADT-driven TOC worklists. No duplicate calls across teams.

AI Data Analyst

Plain-English answers from the canonical record.

Three pains. One root cause. The same OS.

Quality, risk, and care leaders across MA plans, ACOs, IPAs, and medical groups describe the same three pains. They're structural, not vendor-specific, and each one gets fixed at a different layer of the work.

How a physician-led IPA stopped calling the same patient three times.

A physician-led IPA managing 200,000 commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid members across New York. Here's what changed when their teams started working from one shared record.

One canonical record across risk, quality, pharmacy, and care management.

A physician-led IPA serving 200,000 commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid members across New York. Risk adjustment ran out of one set of files. Quality and Stars ran out of another. Pharmacy adherence lived in the PBM portal. Provider performance was assembled in spreadsheets.

Patients fell through the seams between teams. The same member got three calls in the same week: one from risk, one from quality, one from the practice. Sometimes in a language the member didn't speak. Submission windows closed before suspect HCCs surfaced.

One shared record across risk, quality, pharmacy, and care management. Outreach in the right language, only once. RADV-defensible chain-of-custody on every captured HCC. No new headcount.

For the teams that own risk-bearing contracts.

One-liner: The AI Operating System for Auto Shops.
Description: CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops. Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting. CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Hardware, SaaS, B2B, AI, Automotive
target:
The AI operating system for auto shops.

Intake, diagnostics, estimates, scheduling, payments. Every step a shop runs, in one AI system.

Your whole floor, on one board.

Every car in the shop, its next step, and the money attached.

Book a demo to see it on your own cars.

Every handoff stays connected.

Everything you just clicked is one record. The complaint becomes the diagnosis, the diagnosis becomes the quote, and the approved quote becomes the job, without anyone retyping the story.

One job. One signal.

Every handoff updates the floor and the customer automatically, from check-in to collected payment.

Diagnostic copilot

Feed it the codes from whatever scan tool you already run. It weighs them against the customer's complaint and the car's history, then recommends the repair with OEM-grounded reasoning and the exact steps to confirm it.

Customer-ready estimates

Every quote leads with a plain-English explanation, then itemizes parts and labor. The customer approves or declines each line from their phone.

Your alternator isn't charging the battery reliably. The warning light and a slow crank point to it. Replacing it now avoids a no-start and a tow.

Repair Buddy

AI chat grounded in OEM data for the car in front of you. Torque specs, fluid capacities, and component locations, on demand.

Customers always in the loop

Every job gets a live status page that updates as the work moves, with a text at each step and two-way texting back to the shop.

Four AI agents, on shift around the clock.

name: BotCity
brief:
Product: BotCity
One-liner: Observability and Governance for AI-Generated Python scripts.
Description: BotCity is a centralized platform that unifies Python scripts generated by AI or humans under a single governance framework, enabling organizations to scale with orchestration, observability, security and governance.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, Open Source, Infrastructure, AI
target:
The platform to govern Python in the AI era.

Python has become the defining language of the AI era. Every day, business users, technical teams, and AI agents create and run thousands of Python scripts across enterprises. BotCity provides the visibility and control organizations need to govern this entire ecosystem.

We cover the entire Python governance journey

Every team hits Python governance at a different point and BotCity meets you wherever you are. Choose the starting point that fits yours.

AI puts Python in everyone's hands, and thousands of scripts end up running across your company with no one watching. Sentinel maps every one of them and shows you what each is doing, in real time.

Running Python automation at scale means babysitting scripts, servers and schedules by hand. Orchestrator puts scheduling, monitoring, alerts and full operational control in one place.

When AI acts, it writes Python.

Gen AI turned business users into citizen developers. They now generate Python instantly and at scale, across your endpoints. Governance needs to catch up.

The AI era demands Python governance. Sentinel is built for it.

Sentinel gives you a real-time map of every Python script running across your company's endpoints. See who wrote it, what it touches and when it ran, keep a copy of each one, and set the policies and libraries every script has to follow.

Monitor every script execution

See every Python script running across your endpoints, by user, machine, and area, in real time. We detect it whether it runs in a native interpreter, an IDE, or a Jupyter notebook.

Set the rules every script follows

Define policies for use cases, automation, data processing, and communication, and get alerted the moment anything falls out of compliance.

Control what goes into your automations

Make sure only approved, high-quality libraries are used, and that they're free of known vulnerabilities.

Keep a copy of every script

Have a record of every script running in your company for audit, intellectual property protection, and use-case analysis.

With AI, Python became the default for automation.

Tech teams are automating core business processes faster than ever, using AI to generate Python. The faster it ships, the more of it ends up running in production.

Run every business-critical automation with confidence.

When a Python automation becomes business-critical, it needs a governed pipeline: scheduling, monitoring, and full operational control. BotCity Orchestrator gives you that infrastructure, versioned, secured, and run under IT.

name: Lunavo
brief:
Product: Lunavo
One-liner: Lunavo is the AI assistant for carriers.
Description: We build AI that runs carrier operations. Lunavo is the AI assistant for carriers. It plugs directly into their existing toolstack, understands their processes, and monitors all incoming data and requests. Lunavo runs end-to-end backoffice operations, handling repetitive tasks, resolving issues autonomously, and escalating only what matters. Lunavo helps carriers scale operations without scaling headcount.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Logistics, Transportation, Operations, AI Assistant
target:
More loads. Same team. Higher margin.

Lunavo plugs into your TMS, email and portals, runs the repetitive back‑office, and escalates only what matters. Dispatchers stay in the loop. Headcount stays flat. Loads keep moving.

Live at an intermodal forwarder: 180+ orders per day, 5,300+ emails per month. Automated.

Your back‑office is a cost center that scales with load count.

For a carrier running 200 trucks, back‑office headcount typically sits at 30–60 people: dispatchers, billing clerks, tracking teams. None of them move freight. All of them scale linearly with volume.

Repetitive admin eats the day

Dispatchers handle 50–100 emails per hour. Most of them look the same.

Ten tools that don't talk

Teams jump between TMS, portals, email, PDFs, and spreadsheets to close one load.

Billing slips, cash slips

Manual document workflows stretch DSO by 7–14 days and quietly bleed working capital.

Volumes swing. Teams don't.

Spot and contract volumes move 20–40% in a year. Hiring and burnout take turns.

Don't add another dashboard. Add capacity.

Lunavo doesn't sit on top of your operation as a copilot. It sits inside it as an execution layer. Monitoring every inbox, portal and feed. Doing the work.

Lunavo learns your operation. And handles the rest.

Lunavo watches your systems in real time, drafts every reply, updates every portal, and hands you only what needs a human. You review, approve or let it run.

Inbox

Agents

Parsed the order from the ACME portal email, matched it against Master Service Agreement #MSA‑2217, and entered 3 loads into McLeod TMS. Customer has been confirmed over email.

Meet the agents running your back‑office.

Each agent owns one job end‑to‑end. They share context, escalate cleanly, and don't take PTO. Turn them on one at a time, or light them all up.

Dispatches by margin, not by gut.

For every load, Lunavo compares running it on your own fleet, buying freight, and re-selling, calculates the contribution margin in real time, and recommends the best option. You decide with one click instead of five load boards open in parallel.

Automated order intake.

Lunavo reads every request from email, PDF, Excel, extracts the data, applies your customer-specific rules, and creates the load in your TMS. Your first reply ships in seconds, not hours.

Quotes every request the moment it lands.

Lunavo pulls market rates from load boards, your historical lanes and your customer contracts, calculates the optimal margin, and drafts the quote. You approve. The customer gets an answer in minutes.

Audits every freight invoice against the contract.

brief:
Product: Waypoint Transit
One-liner: We automate urban planning so cities can build cheaper and faster.
Description: Waypoint Transit is an AI city planner that generates civil infrastructure studies. Cities spend $50B/year on planning. With Waypoint, cities can generate reports in months rather than years, and at 30% of the cost. Varun and Ryan met at Stanford, where they graduated with degrees in CS and EE respectively. Before founding Waypoint, Varun worked on AI at Microsoft and Ryan worked on chip design at Apple. US cities are facing three major crises: congestion, budget deficits, and climate change.
Industry: Government
target:
City Planning, Accelerated.

Spend less time on routine tasks and more time on the meaningful work only planners can do. Waypoint is the best way to use AI for city planning.

Trusted By.

The Waypoint Assistant

A unified tool that connects to the data sources planners depend on—completing tedious tasks in minutes, not hours.

Run spatial joins, buffer analyses, and complex GIS operations using plain language—no need to remember which button does what.

Comprehensive corridor analysis with data-driven insights for transportation planning and safety improvements.

Streamline your development review process with AI-powered analysis and automated report generation.

Automated safety assessments that identify risks and recommend evidence-based countermeasures.

Support for complete streets and Vision Zero initiatives with multimodal transportation analysis.

Analyze economic impacts of transportation investments and identify opportunities for growth and revitalization.

Built For You

Every municipality and planning firm is unique. We work closely with you to build automations and custom workflows that meet your specific needs.

Permitting Review

Automate permit review against your city's municipal codes and generate memos that match your exact format.

Data Integration

Connect all your data sources—crash reports, GIS layers, transit feeds, and more—into one unified platform.

Credible decks at the speed of AI

Chronicle turns docs, notes, data, and business context into beautiful, fully editable, on‑brand presentations.

Trusted by 5000+ teams for high‑stakes presentations

Paste raw notes, outlines, meeting docs, or existing decks. Chronicle pulls everything into a single presentation.

Go from raw ideas to polished presentations in a click. Chronicle generates stellar, on-brand slides with professional diagrams and visuals.

Present Chronicle and guide audience attention effectively. Export to PPT, PDF, or publish as a website.

brief:
Product: Epicenter
One-liner: ChatGPT's memory feature in an open, portable format
Description: Epicenter is an ecosystem of open-source, local-first apps that share a memory. We store all your work—notes, transcripts, chat histories—in a single folder of plain text and SQLite. Every tool we build shares this memory: your text editor, personal assistant, etc.. It's open, tweakable, and yours. Grep it, open it in Obsidian, host it wherever you like. The choice is yours.
Industry: Consumer
Tags: SaaS, Productivity, Open Source, Note-taking, AI Assistant
target:
Local-First, Open-Source Apps

target:
Manufacturing Runs on Relationships

Your outsourced manufacturing team, in the regions where you need it

Used by 200+ brands across 40+ product categories

What is Sourcify?

Sourcify is the relationship-based sourcing partner for brands that need manufacturing. People who understand your product work with factories they know, backed by boots on the ground across 17 countries.

How it works · Fractional sourcing · Manufacturing regions

Boots on the ground across 17 countries

Local teams and partners support communication, quality, and escalation where manufacturing happens. This map shows presence, not a searchable factory directory.

Finding a factory is not the same as building a manufacturing relationship

Directories and AI tools can produce lists of factory names. They rarely tell you who communicates under pressure, who handles quality consistently, or who stays engaged when something goes wrong. That is the work Sourcify does.

How Sourcify works

We start with human knowledge. Local teams handle communication, quality, and escalation. Technology helps the team stay organized; it does not replace the relationship.

Understand your product and goals

We learn your product, stage, requirements, volumes, timing, and what success looks like before recommending a path.

Present manufacturing fit with context

Factories are introduced by people who understand capabilities, constraints, and commercial alignment, not scraped database rows.

Support execution on the ground

Local teams help with communication, production oversight, quality coordination, and escalation across manufacturing regions.

Stay involved as needs grow

From diversification and category expansion to Managed Manufacturing, we help the relationship progress over time.

Manufacturing support that matches how you operate

Four ways brands work with Sourcify. Each is grounded in relationship-based sourcing and leads to a Discovery Call when it fits.

Managed manufacturing

Sourcify's core offer: an embedded manufacturing operations partnership across factories, quality, logistics, and strategy — with boots on the ground.

Product manufacturing

Project support from factory fit and sampling through production oversight and delivery — a common ramp into Managed Manufacturing.

Fractional sourcing

Ongoing support for manufacturing operations without a full internal sourcing team — a lighter ramp that often expands into Managed.

Factory diversification

Structured work to reduce concentration and tariff risk: second sources, China+1 strategy, and relationship-based transitions.

Trusted by brands navigating real manufacturing complexity

Years of manufacturing relationships

Countries with boots on the ground

Brands supported

In sourced products
