name: Seal
brief:
Product: Seal
One-liner: All-in-one workspace for companies making regulated products
Industry: B2B / Operations
Tags: Documents
target:
GxP that learns.

One intelligence across the systems you use.

Start with a question buried in your records. neil reads across your instruments, LIMS, QMS and documents, brings the evidence together and drafts the investigation in Seal.

Inspect the sources. Review the reasoning. Give neil the next piece of work with the context already in place.

Why is post-thaw viability falling?

Longer holds coincide with lower viability. All eight runs stayed within the approved limit.

Investigate the hold. Review a shorter limit. 3 sources attached for review

A platform you and neil can build on.

Give neil an SOP, batch record or form. Together, you configure a process that runs in Seal: steps, checks, review gates and a validation pack.

Start from 120 GxP blueprints , configured around your procedures and equipment. Each run keeps its readings, signatures and deviations together. That becomes neil's context for the next job.

SOP-QA-014 Rev 4.pdf

Keep the product at 2 to 8 °C for no more than 45 minutes before testing.

Viability must be at least 90%.

One record across your operations.

Every value, signature and deviation, tied to the step that produced it. Instruments, ERP lots and LIMS samples land on it instead of being retyped. Development, manufacturing, QC and quality work on that one record. neil learns from all of it. An inspector sees all of it.

neil proposes. Your team decides.

Each run gives neil more context to suggest an improvement. Your team assesses the change and approves what goes live. Seal keeps the evidence, training and version history with the work.

Continuous validation is built into Seal. Requirements, configuration, automated checks and release evidence stay connected.

CAR-T release

Revision v04 → v05

03 / Post-thaw hold

Hold the thawed product at 2 to 8 °C for no more than 45 30 minutes before the viability count.

Proposed by neil from evidence across 8 runs.

brief:
Product: CareOasis
One-liner: Get Paid for Family Caregiving
Industry: Healthcare / Consumer Health and Wellness
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Healthcare, Health Insurance
target:
You Already Care for Them. Now, Get Paid for It.

CareOasis helps Ohio families turn home caregiving into a supported, paid role. Secure your loved one’s comfort while securing your financial future.

Become a Paid Caregiver in Ohio

When a family member or friend needs in-home care due to age, disability, or illness, it’s often a loved one who steps up to help. If you’re already providing daily care, you may be wondering: can I get paid for this in Ohio? The good news is—yes, in many cases, you can.

CareOasis helps family caregivers in Ohio get paid for the care they provide.

Not in Ohio?

CareOasis currently serves Ohio families, but paid family caregiving programs exist across the country. Our free state-by-state guides explain how to get paid for caring for a loved one where you live.

How to Apply for Caregiver Compensation in 4 Easy Steps

We make the process as simple as possible, with a dedicated team to support you along the way.

1. Check Eligibility

Use our simple online form to see if you and your loved one qualify. We'll ask a few basic questions about your caregiving situation and the care recipient's needs.

2. Complete Enrollment

Our team will guide you through the enrollment process for the right Ohio Medicaid program, whether it's PASSPORT, MyCare, or Structured Family Caregiving. We handle the paperwork so you can focus on what matters.

3. Get Certified & Trained

We provide or connect you with the necessary training to meet state requirements. Our goal is to ensure you feel confident and prepared in your role as a paid caregiver.

4. Start Receiving Pay

brief:
Product: Hook0: Free Webhook Platform, HMAC Signatures, EU Hosting
Description: Free webhook platform with HMAC signatures, configurable retries, and delivery monitoring. Self-host the SSPL code or use our EU-hosted cloud. No credit card.
target:
Webhooks As A Service

Hook0 is an Open-Source Webhooks-as-a-service (WaaS) that makes it easy for developers to send webhooks. Developers make one API call, and Hook0 takes care of deliverability, retries, security, and more.

Trusted by companies worldwide

These teams chose Hook0 over competitors because Hook0 publishes its full server source (SSPL-1.0) and also offers production-ready SaaS support. They gain a competitive advantage by embracing extensibility, reversibility, and future-proofness in their integration strategies.

Set up webhooks in 10 minutes

From signup to production in three steps

Register & Configure

Create an account, add your application, and list the event types your subscribers can receive.

Send Events via API

POST your event once. Hook0 delivers it, retries on failure, signs the payload, and encrypts over TLS.

Monitor & Debug

See every delivery attempt, inspect payloads, find out why a delivery failed, and replay events from the dashboard or API.

Out-Of-The-Box Webhooks

Everything you need to build a state-of-the-art webhooks solution in minutes

Open-Source

Unlike alternatives, Hook0 is fully open-source . No vendor-locking, we are here to stay, no investors, we are fully sustainable since day 1.

Easy Integration

Our JSON REST API , SDKs , and MCP Server for AI assistants make it easy to trigger webhook events from your application and let your users connect to every available SaaS.

Signed & Encrypted

All webhooks are TLS secured and contain a cryptographic signature to prevent forgery, replay, man-in-the-middle attacks.

Configurable Retries

Two-phase retry schedules configurable per subscription: fast retries with increasing delays, then slow retries at fixed intervals. Smart defaults included, full control when you need it.

Make Your Subscribers Happy

Give your users a primo experience with our mock payloads, webhook logs and subscriber portal.

Transparent Webhooks

All webhook attempts are logged so you and your subscribers can easily search, debug and replay old events.

Embeddable Portal

Give your subscribers a branded experience with a custom subdomain and your logo uploaded on the subscriber portal.

Precise Dispatch

Your users only receive webhooks they subscribed to. You can filter each subscription by business info (user ID, …).

Data & Sovereignty

Hook0 does not lock your data nor your software. If you subscribe to Hook0 SaaS version, all your data will stay in Europe. No GAFAM there.

All-in-one platform

Build a state-of-the-art webhooks solution in minutes using Hook0

Fine-grained subscriptions

Enable your users to subscribe to your events by setting up a webhook. They can choose which event types they want to receive.

One-liner: AI Models for GIS
Description: Bunting Labs researches and develops custom AI models for surveying and GIS.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, SaaS, Geographic Information System, B2B, Web Development
target:
The Suite of AI Tools Built Into QGIS

Digitize features in geologic maps, as-builts, aerial imagery etc. in half the time with our AI Vectorizer.

Kue can read and edit your QGIS project, integrating a chatbot with your map data.

Our AI model scans your map and places control points. All you have to do is review and accept them.

Converts legal descriptions and deeds into vector geometries using AI (extracts metes and bounds).

TRUSTED BY 30+ GOVERNMENTS AROUND THE WORLD

United States

United Kingdom

BACKED BY

Kue can run 311 geoprocessing algorithms

Filter and select without writing SQL

Kue can style any layer

Scale Dependent

Chooses minimum and max zoom level that features and labels will be visible, based on the content of your vector layers.

Geometry Styling

Defines visual appearance through layered symbols (fill, line, marker) with configurable patterns, colors, and borders for each geometry type.

Label Engine

Controls text rendering with font properties, collision detection, buffers/shadows, and placement rules relative to features.

Conditional Rendering

Uses QGIS expressions to show, hide, or style features based on their attributes, area / length, or other properties.

Conflict Resolution

Manages feature/label density through priority fields, obstacle weights, and maximum label counts per view.

" This is a really great plugin that helps you trace vectors in a very easy and fast way " , as featured in his YouTube review of our plugin .

Professor Hans van der Kwast

" This is an absolutely perfect use of AI in geospatial. It takes a very manual and time-consuming task and passes that off to AI while still being able to have human intervention when needed. Amazing work! "

Matt Forrest

Description: ARC Prize builds AI benchmarks that measure general intelligence. Our benchmark, ARC-AGI, has been used by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and xAI. Founded by Mike Knoop and Francois Chollet, we inspire open source artificial general intelligence (AGI) research through benchmarks (the ARC-AGI series), global competitions, research grants, community, and content, we exist to guide researchers, industry, and regulators on the path to AGI.

target:
The North Star for AGI

ARC Prize Foundation is a nonprofit advancing open-source artificial general intelligence research through benchmarks & prizes.

Enter ARC Prize 2026 Now $2,000,000 in prizes!

Top AI Leaders and Partners

ARC Prize is a provider of AI benchmarks to NIST’s Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI)

Low-Noise, High-Signal AGI Benchmarks

We build scientifically grounded benchmarks that reveal the gap between what's easy for humans, hard for AI.

ARC-AGI has repeatedly identified key inflection points in AI progress, including the emergence of reasoning systems and the rise of capable AI agents.

New ideas still needed for AGI.

While AI has made tremendous progress, ARC-AGI shows us scaling alone will not reach AGI.

Our mission is simple: guide research, accelerate progress, and ensure the path to AGI remains open and accessible to all.

We define AGI as a system that can match the learning efficiency of humans.

Introducing ARC-AGI-3. The world's only unbeaten benchmark that measures agentic intelligence.

ARC-AGI Benchmark Series

Trusted by the world's leading AI labs and top academic researchers, explore the only benchmark that measures fluid intelligence. It's easy for humans, hard for AI.

Big ideas. Big money.

Get rewarded for open sourcing novel progress. In partnership with Kaggle, over $2M is up for grabs.

Founder Message

“AGI is the most important technology humanity will create, and we believe it is achievable in our lifetime. But ARC shows us we still need new ideas. Maybe they'll come from you?”

Mike Knoop (Zapier, Ndea ) & François Chollet (Keras, Ndea, ARC-AGI)

name: Goldbridge
brief:
Product: Goldbridge
One-liner: Ramp for Real Estate
Description: Goldbridge is building the financial operating system for the largest asset class in the world – real estate. More than $1T in rent flows through landlord bank accounts annually, with roughly a quarter locked in idle reserves and security deposits – and billions more leaking from unnecessary property expenses. And with $2.5T in real estate loans about to mature in 2027/28, property owners are desperate to boost their income ASAP.
Industry: Real Estate and Construction / Housing and Real Estate
Tags: Real Estate, Finance, Proptech, Neobank, AI
target:
Every property leaks cash. Until you use Goldbridge.

Connect all your accounts, scan portfolio spend, and uncover hidden NOI across property taxes, vendors, utilities, rebates and idle cash.

Connecting to your PMS...

Establishing secure connection

Works with the systems you already use

Goldbridge finds savings where owners lose the most

From tax bills to vendor contracts, Goldbridge finds the biggest financial leaks across your portfolio and helps you act on them.

How Goldbridge works

Connect your systems

Securely link your property management system and other related accounts.

Goldbridge scans your portfolio

Analyze invoices, contracts, bills, balances, and payment flows.

Review and act

Prioritize opportunities by impact and turn insights into NOI.

Most products spend. Goldbridge saves.

Your bank moves money. Your software tracks operations. Goldbridge finds the financial opportunities hiding between them.

Where Goldbridge finds hidden NOI

Goldbridge helps owners uncover savings across the biggest sources of financial leakage in a real estate portfolio.

Property tax savings

Identify reassessment opportunities and appeal candidates across your portfolio before overpayments compound.

Vendor contract savings

Spot overpriced contracts, renewal risk, and vendors charging above portfolio benchmarks.

Utility and invoice anomalies

Catch leaks, overbilling, duplicate charges, and unusual spikes before they drag down NOI.

Idle cash optimization

Find reserve and operating cash that should be earning more while keeping portfolio controls intact.

Max Abdol

MFR portfolio / California

Ready to boost your NOI?

Schedule time with us and we'll show you the power of Goldbridge — the spend intelligence platform built for real estate.

name: RocketLit
brief:
Product: RocketLit
One-liner: RocketLit is an adaptive learning and assessment platform.
Description: RocketLit gives all students better access to learning and educators access to the data they need to be most impactful. Our first product, RocketLit, is an adaptive and personalized learning platform that serves reading to students at their independent level. Students read the same content at different levels of complexity and fluidly move up reading levels as they improve.
Industry: Education
Tags: Education, Edtech
target:
Education tailored and adapted to each student's reading level

Reading Levels Diagnosed

We figure out what your students need and personalize reading to each student's own reading level.

Adaptive Reading

As comprehension improves, we constantly adapt student reading levels by moving each student up and down when they're ready.

Engaging Curriculum Based on Standards

Find tons of NGSS aligned non-fiction in one place, written in a fun voice students love, filled with analogies they can grasp.

Students Start with Diagnostics

Your students read three short articles, each followed by a quiz. This sets their initial reading level for upcoming assignments.

Students Always Read Articles at Their Current Reading Level

After reading, your students take a multiple choice quiz and their reading level adapts based on how well they do.

Annotations and Highlighting

Students can highlight, circle, and underline text then attach their own notes for teachers to look over.

Free Response Questions

These come at the end of a quiz, right after the multiple choice section, and can be turned on or off for any assignment.

Articles Read Aloud and Highlighted

Students at lower reading levels or those who need to can listen to the article while following along as text is highlighted.

Receive Reports to Inform Future Instruction

Quickly see what vocabulary words students struggled with to help you focus on reteaching troublesome concepts.

Easily Assign NGSS Aligned Articles

Sort articles by NGSS Performance Expectations or Cross-Cutting Concepts. You can also browse by unit or search for specific terms.

More than a Gradebook

Use our gradebook to see how students improve over time or with retries. You can calculate averages on the fly as well as export all of your data.

Print All Reading Levels

We have print-optimized PDF versions of every article for every reading level. Symbols mark each reading level so you know who gets which version.

Shareable Reports

Easily shareable reports let you give coaches and admin digestible visual data about how your students are progressing.

Experience

as a student

as a teacher

Teachers, get a free one month trial!

Get RocketLit Science and History for use in your classroom for one month, absolutely free.

What Educators Say

It’s a resource students have been motivated to read because the articles are interesting and well-written. It is rewarding to see that after reading the articles and taking the free response questions, they do understand the concepts.

brief:
Product: ClaimSorted
One-liner: Making it easy for insurance companies to process claims
Description: ClaimSorted helps insurance companies remove the hassle of managing claims by enabling them to outsource their claim operations to us. This service is known as a Third Party Administrator (TPA). Unlike traditional TPAs, we blend AI and best-in-class experts to deliver a 5-star customer experience, minimise mistakes and speed up claim assessment.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
target:
Tech-Enabled Claims TPA

Turning Claims Into Your Advantage

We deliver a five-star claims experience to your policyholders while reducing your operational and indemnity costs. We do this by combining the best claims talent in the market with our proprietary technology.

Trusted by 30+ leading MGAs and Carriers

Performance that speaks for itself

Faster Claims Cycle

3x speed

Measured against market-standard TPA cycle times

Lower Claims Leakage

Below 1.2%

Based on audits from our insurance partners

Reduced Reopen Rates

Below 1.0%

Based on claims reopened within 30 days timeframe

We do this by combining human empathy with the latest technology

Policyholder Experience

We create a white-label eNOL that can be fully customized to your brand and program. Policyholders also get access to a white-label Claims Portal to track claim statuses, ask questions, and upload additional documents

Claims Assessment

We design workflows around your policy wording, claims philosophy, brand guidelines and tone of voice. Our structured approach to eligibility checks ensures minimal leakage

Fraud Detection

Our proprietary algorithms flag unusual patterns, document tampering and excessive costs. The system can also flag opportunities for recoveries and subrogation

Reporting

You can choose from a range of reporting options: daily, weekly, monthly, or live data feeds via SFTP or API so you get insights when you need them.

name: GetAppNiche — App Store Intelligence & App Niche Research
brief:
Product: GetAppNiche — App Store Intelligence & App Niche Research
Description: Find profitable app niches with proven demand and room to compete. Compare modeled revenue, competition and review signals across 3.6M+ apps.
target:
Find your next profitable app niche — before everyone else.

GetAppNiche tracks revenue, downloads, keywords, ads and reviews across 3.6M+ apps on the App Store and Google Play — so you can validate ideas, win ASO, and outsmart bigger competitors to build before you spend months coding.

Need the full workspace? Get Pro →

Real apps, real estimates

Three candidates surfaced by the data

Not random ideas. Markets with evidence.

Each candidate combines multiple modeled earners with relatively light incumbent mass. Use these as a focused shortlist for deeper validation.

Teleprompter tools

659 median ratings among modeled winners — our proxy for incumbent mass.

Why it surfaced Professional users pay for a focused workflow, while the typical winner is still relatively lightly entrenched.

Validate next Creator-specific keyword demand and recurring complaints in competitor reviews.

Writing tools

1,512 median ratings among modeled winners — our proxy for incumbent mass.

Why it surfaced Multiple proven earners without a single giant owning every workflow or audience.

Validate next A profession, format or job where a specialist editor can beat a generic assistant.

Pilates apps

1,254 median ratings among modeled winners — our proxy for incumbent mass.

Why it surfaced A subscription-friendly market where winning apps look more like reachable peers than decade-old institutions.

Validate next Audience wedge, instructor credibility and retention beyond the first training plan.

Buckets use App Store title-keyword matches. Revenue figures are directional estimates modeled from public store signals. “Winner” means est. revenue of $1K+/month. Rating count is an incumbent-mass proxy, not keyword difficulty.

New · Localization Gap Finder

Find the markets the winners forgot to translate

Every storefront has top-ranked apps that never localized. GetAppNiche flags, for any keyword or category, which winning apps ship no localization in your target language — a ready-made shortlist of localization gaps across 40+ languages, from Italian to Japanese.

15 of top 20 not localized in Italian — localization opening

Real keyword, real ranks — Italian App Store, August 2026

Spot the gap in Explore

Filter any category by “Not localized in” your language — successful apps with revenue, downloads and zero presence in the customer’s language.

Verify the search results

Track the keyword in the target storefront. One click shows every top-ranked app — and a badge for whether it ships your language.

Be the localized one

App Store search ranks per storefront, so a fully localized listing against un-translated incumbents is often the cheapest wedge in ASO.
